scope: Finance, grants, registry filings and compliance module integration audit
implementation: BC society pre-fill and preparation assistant enforce entity/jurisdiction/form eligibility; canonical BCSocietyAnnualReport alias creates a real six-step run.
Read-only filing packet now uses identical portable and native handlers, including real workspace directors and annual meeting data offline.
Filing summaries and assistant packet enforce each composed read resource for scoped service principals.
CRA pre-fill validates form/year, gates T3010 to registered charities and uses clamped UTC calendar-month deadlines.
Accounting CSV and auditor package require financial read plus exports:download; UI does not query or download exports without authority.
Member/Viewer source-to-grant pipeline controls disabled; local grant feed discovery explicitly unavailable while manual candidates stay editable.
Filing checklist, formation maintenance, pre-fill, actual DOCX export and official registry handoffs connected; preparation notifications route to /app/filings.

browser.kind: Browser-local demo runtime; not hosted provider qualification
browser.retest: Initial concurrent development-server cold-load/HMR timeouts were rerun on frozen E2E server, one worker. All unresolved cases passed.

verification.native_and_portable_integration: scripts/check-filing-preparation-integration.ts passed: actual native and local packets; annual alias; six-step native run; unsupported run creates no row; jurisdiction/type/form/charity/year gates; Member and foreign-workspace denial; Viewer accounting export denial; docs-only/filings-only/every-missing-resource service denial and combined-scope positive; leap-year deadline clamp.
verification.typecheck: App and Convex passed; final repeat after service-scope guard addition recorded in ignored tmp/module-finance-*-typecheck-final.log.
verification.lint: Scoped lint: zero errors; existing max-lines warnings and ignored nonconfigured shared/test files.

remaining_limits: Detailed Filings and per-year AnnualFilings are separate manual ledgers linked in the interface; recording one does not automatically change the other.
BC preparation assistant supports annual report, bylaw amendment and change of directors. It prepares records only; users review signatures/evidence and submit through the official portal.
Other jurisdiction registry preparation uses the existing formation/checklist/document pathway and official manual submission; no automated registry or CRA submission was qualified.

Live Wave synchronization, external grant feeds and registry imports require online mode, configured server/provider credentials and actual authorized external sessions; this audit does not claim those providers were live-tested.
